questions.question: Linux boot jarayoni bosqichlari qanday?
questions.explanation: Firmware (BIOS/UEFI) → bootloader (GRUB2) → kernel + initramfs → init (systemd, PID 1) → target/runlevel → servislar → login.

questions.question: BIOS va UEFI farqi? MBR va GPT?
questions.explanation: BIOS — eski, MBR'dan 446 bayt kod o'qiydi, disk 2TB, 4 primary partition. UEFI — ESP (FAT32) dan .efi fayl, GPT, 128+ partition, Secure Boot.

questions.question: GRUB2 nima? Konfiguratsiyasi qayerda va qanday o'zgartiriladi?
questions.explanation: Bootloader: kernel tanlash menyusi, kernel + initramfs yuklaydi, cmdline uzatadi. `/etc/default/grub` tahrirlanadi, keyin `update-grub` / `grub2-mkconfig -o ...`. `grub.cfg`ni qo'lda tahrirlama.

questions.question: initramfs (initrd) nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Kernel bilan yuklanadigan vaqtinchalik root FS (cpio arxiv): root diskni mount qilish uchun driver/vosita (LVM, RAID, LUKS, NVMe modul). Keyin `switch_root` haqiqiy root'ga.

questions.question: Kernel command line nima? Foydali parametrlar.
questions.explanation: Bootloader kernel'ga uzatadigan parametrlar: `root=`, `ro`, `quiet`, `init=`, `systemd.unit=`, `console=`, `mitigations=`, `cgroup` sozlamalari. `/proc/cmdline` da ko'rinadi.

questions.question: Runlevel nima? 0–6 qiymatlari.
questions.explanation: SysV init holatlari: 0 halt, 1 single-user, 2–4 multi-user (distroga qarab), 3 multi-user + network (text), 5 graphical, 6 reboot.

questions.question: SysV init va systemd farqi? Runlevel'lar systemd'da qanday ifodalangan?
questions.explanation: SysV — ketma-ket shell skriptlar (`/etc/rc3.d/S20foo`), runlevel. systemd — parallel, dependency graph, unit'lar, target'lar (runlevel o'rnida), socket/cgroup orqali boshqaruv.

questions.question: Default target'ni qanday ko'rasan va o'zgartirasan? Joriy holatda boshqasiga qanday o'tasan?
questions.explanation: `systemctl get-default`, `systemctl set-default multi-user.target`; joriy sessiyada — `systemctl isolate rescue.target`.

questions.question: rescue.target va emergency.target farqi? Qachon qaysi?
questions.explanation: rescue — single-user: local FS mount, asosiy servislar, network yo'q, root shell. emergency — eng minimal: root `/` read-only, boshqa hech narsa mount yo'q. FS/fstab buzilganda — emergency.

questions.question: Root parolni unutding yoki fstab xatosi tufayli server boot bo'lmayapti. Qanday tiklaysan?
questions.explanation: Console orqali GRUB'da `e`; `rd.break` (RHEL) yoki `init=/bin/bash`; `/sysroot` ni rw remount, `chroot`, `passwd`, SELinux uchun `touch /.autorelabel`. Cloud'da — serial console yoki diskni boshqa VM'ga ulash.

questions.question: Secure Boot nima va boot zanjiri qanday tekshiriladi?
questions.explanation: UEFI faqat imzolangan bootloader'ni ishga tushiradi: firmware -> shim (Microsoft imzosi) -> GRUB (distro kaliti) -> kernel -> imzolangan modullar. MOK — o'z kalitlaring. Bootkit/rootkit'dan himoya.

questions.question: Boot sekin. Qaysi servis aybdorligini qanday aniqlaysan?
questions.explanation: `systemd-analyze` (firmware/loader/kernel/userspace vaqti), `systemd-analyze blame`, `critical-chain`, `plot > boot.svg`; `journalctl -b` timeout'lar (masalan, network-online, fstab'dagi yo'q disk 90s).

questions.question: systemd target'lar va `WantedBy=multi-user.target` nima? `systemctl enable` aslida nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Target — unit'lar guruhi (sinxronizatsiya nuqtasi). `enable` `[Install]` bo'yicha `/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/` ga symlink yaratadi — target ishga tushganda servis ham tortiladi.

questions.question: Katta fleet'da kernel yangilash va boot xavfsizligini qanday tashkil qilasan?
questions.explanation: Canary/rolling reboot, A/B yoki fallback kernel (`grub-reboot`, `GRUB_DEFAULT=saved`), livepatch (kpatch/Livepatch) kritik CVE uchun, console/serial access, avtomatik health check va rollback, PodDisruptionBudget/drain.
